title: Sandustry Beginner Guide — First Hours in Early Access
description: A practical Sandustry beginner guide: dig sand, refine value, place early conveyors, and avoid common Early Access bottlenecks.
note: Early Access systems change. Prefer Steam news and the official Hooded Horse wiki for patch-sensitive recipes.

sections.h2: What you are trying to do
paragraphs: Sandustry is a dig-and-automate sandbox. The Steam pitch is simple: dig into a living sand planet, sift value from materials (starting with wet sand toward gold), then replace manual hauling with buildings that move, filter, and process pixels for you.
Your first session should answer three questions: Can I dig safely? Can I refine something valuable? Can I move materials without walking every load?
Dig a compact starter pit near your first refining setup instead of tunneling randomly.
Follow the in-game prompts and early objectives for the shaker–refine path Steam highlights.
Place a short conveyor or launcher as soon as throughput hurts — do not wait until the base is huge.
Keep one clear dump zone so sand, ore, and byproducts do not bury your machines.
Save a clean layout snapshot before big digs; pixel physics means mistakes cascade.
Mixing every material on one belt without filters.
Ignoring water and wet sand interactions until the dig floods or dries the wrong zone.
Expanding the dig face faster than refining capacity.
Treating the free demo and full EA as identical — content depth differs; use the demo to check performance and the core loop.
Read Automation Tips for belt and filter habits, Water Basics if fluids are blocking progress, and the Demo Guide if you have not bought Early Access yet.
For patch-level recipes and building stats, cross-check the official Hooded Horse wiki and Steam news — this fan site stays high-level so EA churn does not invent false numbers.

faq.a: There is a free Steam demo. The full game is paid Early Access on Steam (app 2764460).
Steam lists Early Access on August 13, 2026, with roughly a year of planned EA updates noted on the store page.
Developer Lantto Games; publisher Hooded Horse.
